name: aws_connect_instance
description: Creates an Amazon Connect instance for deploying cloud-based contact centers with omnichannel customer service capabilities.

inbound_calls_enabled.name: inbound_calls_enabled
inbound_calls_enabled.description: Specifies whether your contact center handles incoming contacts.

outbound_calls_enabled.name: outbound_calls_enabled
outbound_calls_enabled.description: Specifies whether your contact center allows outbound calls.

instance_alias.name: instance_alias
instance_alias.description: Specifies the name of the instance. Required if directory_id not specified.

directory_id.name: directory_id
directory_id.description: The identifier for the directory if identity_management_type is EXISTING_DIRECTORY.

auto_resolve_best_voices_enabled.name: auto_resolve_best_voices_enabled
auto_resolve_best_voices_enabled.description: Specifies whether auto resolve best voices is enabled.

contact_flow_logs_enabled.name: contact_flow_logs_enabled
contact_flow_logs_enabled.description: Specifies whether contact flow logs are enabled.

contact_lens_enabled.name: contact_lens_enabled
contact_lens_enabled.description: Specifies whether contact lens is enabled.

early_media_enabled.name: early_media_enabled
early_media_enabled.description: Specifies whether early media for outbound calls is enabled.

multi_party_conference_enabled.name: multi_party_conference_enabled
multi_party_conference_enabled.description: Specifies whether multi-party calls/conference is enabled.
